### A Place to Run To
Author: Jill Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-women/a-place-to-run-to-one-year-devotions-for-women-january-31.html
Passage: Joshua 20:2
Points:
- God commanded Israel to establish strategically located cities of refuge across the promised land.
- These cities offered a fair hearing and safe shelter for those who had caused an accidental death.
- The ancient sanctuary system pictures God's role as our ultimate shelter and just judge in times of distress.
- Believers facing mistakes, guilt, or painful circumstances can flee directly to God to find help and restoration.

### Designating Cities of Refuge
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/designating-cities-of-refuge
Passage: Joshua 20:1-3
Points:
- God incorporated grace into the law by providing safe havens within a day's journey for all Israelites.
- The elders held an initial inquiry to verify that the death was accidental, ensuring mercy did not compromise justice.
- A manslayer's freedom upon the death of the high priest prefigured Christ, whose death secures atonement for believers.
- The cities of refuge affirm the sacred value of human life while displaying God's balance of righteousness and compassion.
